creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Background handles with `.wait()` and `.done`, plus a `poll(every=, timeout=, fn)` helper. The report proposing it rates it low-to-medium confidence and recommends landing the cheaper proposals first, calling it design-heavy.

Now adjacent to a prioritized item: the parallelism card in big-rocks covers fan-out, and the main board's `RAD-329: Spawn a separate background process` covers detached processes. If the parallelism design ends up needing a handle type, revisit this rather than inventing a second one.
title: spawn and poll process primitives
